verdicts.title: Symmetric Decompositions and the Strong Sperner Property for Noncrossing Partition Lattices
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that the noncrossing partition lattices associated with the complex reflection groups $G(d,d,n)$ for $d,n\geq 2$ admit symmetric decompositions into Boolean subposets. verdicts.title: Noncrossing partitions of a marked surface
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We define noncrossing partitions of a marked surface without punctures (interior marked points). We show that the natural partial order on noncrossing partitions is a graded lattice and describe its rank function topologically.
